tools.name: find_fix
tools.description: Find existing products that remove a specific work bottleneck: active YC startups, open-source GitHub repos and Show HN launches (~46k). Call it when the user complains that something is slow, manual, repetitive or error-prone (in a team, workflow or codebase), or asks "is there a tool/library/start

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Raw full-text search over the same index, without LLM ranking: fast, cheap, more candidates. Use for broad discovery or to judge fit yourself. Pass 3-16 English keywords: the job to be done, product category, synonyms, key technical nouns (e.g. ["transcription", "call notes", "crm", "sales"]). Candi
